name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: One-year personal accident insurance scheme, renewable every year, covering death or disability due to an accident.
implementingAuthority: Public sector and other general insurance companies through banks

evidence.quote: is available to people in the age group of 18 to 70 years having a bank account and who give their consent to join and enable auto-debit.

benefits.text: Rs. 2 lakh on accidental death or permanent total disability; Rs. 1 lakh on partial disability. Premium Rs 20 per year.

evidence.quote: Benefit of Rs. 2 Lakh payable on death or permanent total disability and Rs. 1 Lakh on partial disability.

applicationProcess: Enrol through your bank. The premium is auto-debited from your account.
